# Independent scientific review of record 240

Recommend acceptance of the exact 78,254-byte draft `e2b0c7f36f10ab3e2ff8cc20362b961dec5ad1193dd3fce796a3c5fb6d879b78`. There are no supported required findings. This decision covers scientific curation of PathBank SMP0002097, not authority integration, a native maintained review record, adoption, publication or licensing.

I authored the preceding eligibility preflight, but did not author this YAML. I freshly read the complete draft and judged its evidence independently. The preflight's global novelty search is inherited and explicitly identified; it is not presented as a second independent discovery exercise. The sealed author and preflight packets remain unchanged.

The review covers all 18 narrative paragraphs, 58 complete edges, four endpoint qualifiers, 43 identities, 42 references and 100 evidence locators. Each paragraph, whole edge, qualifier and identity has a separately saved appraisal. Schema and strict validation pass against the freshly rebound local contracts. All evidence locators resolve against complete preserved originals, with acquisition receipts checked; resolution is a mechanical supplement to the scientific readings, not the scientific judgment itself.

I read all three complete accessible HTML main articles, their Methods, Results, Discussion, tables, captions and references, and visually inspected all 19 figures at original detail. I also read all five scanned pages of the 1986 speE/speD paper, including its tables, figures, references and note added in proof. All 14 available PubMed abstracts and the metadata-only 1973 citation were freshly read. The four main articles are PMID 17124497, 20530482, 19542271 and 3526348. Older papers beyond these remain abstract, metadata or reviewed-annotation evidence. Neither of the two unsuccessful SI downloads is treated as scientific content.

The fresh native replay covers every one of the 208 current BioPAX objects and all 22 conversion/transport sides with coefficients and directions. It verifies native assembly coefficients 8/2/2/2, controller assignments, physical-instance locations, pathway membership and inferred continuity. All 86 selected PWML biological-frame projections match their original frames, with complete scalar chemical identities checked. I manually read the complete relevant pathway, species, protein, complex, reaction and transport frames; unrelated species, drawing geometry and every compound background narrative were not all manually read. The original undeclared `option` prefix is preserved; only in-memory inspection adds a temporary namespace. No repaired document replaces an issuer original.

The archived map has 139 objects; the current map has 208. The exact comparison finds 69 added objects, 138 unchanged objects, no removals, and only the main pathway object changed. This confirms that the Gss branch and SAM interface extend the older map while its old events are preserved. The record retains the full current route rather than following the stale three-enzyme narrative.

All four complete UniProt scientific frames were read and compared, including 51 comments, 204 features, 44 reference contexts and full sequences of 264, 288, 232 and 619 residues. The independent kinetic check verifies ten complete property groups, 20 individual Km/Vmax entries, two turnover-note objects and the entire 2006 Table 1, including all ten mutant rows. The author's legacy `individual_numeric_Km_Vmax_slots` counter of 22 includes the two note objects; this report distinguishes them. The draft quotes only the supported wild-type 2006 constants with assay qualifications. No co-cited older constants are reassigned to individual unread papers.

The principal scientific boundaries are correctly preserved:

- SpeD's eight encoded precursors remain an unresolved native assertion alongside the mature four-alpha/beta-pair evidence and older conflicting subunit report. Covalent pyruvoyl is separate from free pyruvic acid, and alternative activating cations do not become simultaneous cellular requirements.
- SpeE's ambiguous SAM-labelled donor Km values remain annotation ambiguities. Native full-length Pfs is separate from the engineered N-terminal deletion and from adjacent nucleosidase substrates.
- The native Gss equation is ATP-dependent ligation despite an amidase EC label. Synthetase and amidase reactions, full-length and fragment constructs, crystal and kinetic preparations, and proposed versus obligatory intermediates remain separate. Main-text redox results qualify the broader abstract wording.
- Native MTR transport is retained without an invented transporter or energy source. The export abstract concerns extracellular MTR in T3-SAMase/metK constructs; it does not establish a periplasmic transport mechanism. The SAM interface remains an unresolved generic Interaction.
- E. coli species, K-12 protein context and BW25113 identifier are distinct. No universal spermidine-essentiality or all-strain whole-route phenotype is inferred.
- Full structure comparisons reject exact MTA stereochemical, cyclic/open-chain MTR and phosphoric-acid/phosphate mappings. Incorrect native GSH and magnesium cross-references are disclosed. Only four UniProt namespace normalizations are exported; there is no exact state-to-parent or Rhea equation mapping.

The complete 18 chemical originals and three-taxon XML support the selected identity appraisals. In total, the final check freshly binds 177 source, receipt, contract and historical files, with no missing-descriptor skip. Fresh hidden/ignored-inclusive closures cover all 169 + 2 author and 192 + 2 preflight artifacts, including literal-alias checks. Large original trees are bound through these exact packets rather than copied redundantly.

Six wrapped executions are retained: intake and native replay passed; the first final checker failed on the reviewer's incorrect `organisms` key, then the corrected checker passed; the first appraisal failed because the reviewer assumed a `displayName` slot for cellular-location vocabulary, then the corrected appraisal passed using its actual `term` slot. Exact failed helper bodies, partial outputs, receipts, stdout and stderr survive. Corrections also replace unobserved evidence-field/HTML-ID assumptions with the actual record description and table content. These were reviewer helper errors, not draft defects. The ancillary missing-file diagnostic, an accidental nonexistent-script command and a rejected no-change patch attempt are disclosed in the provenance notes. No source or draft was edited. The phrase “all four wrapped checks” in generated provenance refers to the four successful executions; there are six total executions including two failures.

No new network fetch, native/full builder, maintained test suite, shared-cache mutation, Git operation, publication or native review saving was performed. Root's separate static graph preview is not a maintained-page or interactive-browser acceptance claim and is not used to substitute for this review. Authority design and native validation remain subsequent work.

The independent transformation derives every mapping from the old selected IDs and the complete issuing BioPAX, rather than accepting the author's substitution list. Their current absence from the profile's projection is explicitly unresolved, and does not justify removing these nodes, treating an Interaction as a measured conversion, or changing their biological interpretation. The profile replay supports the scope correction but is not full authority validation.

The four source mapping rows are exactly unchanged. Their native `ProteinReference/...` source-element values are RDF keys, not selected PathBank CURIEs. Each whole ProteinReference and linked UniProt UnificationXref was freshly resolved, checked and saved. Every one of the 100 evidence locators was independently replayed; the full matched results are identical to both the predecessor and successor checks.
